tour.title: How to use the Code tab

intro.title: This is the Code tab
intro.body: Here an AI agent reads and writes files in a folder on your computer — it can build, fix, and refactor real projects. Let me point out the main controls.

folder.title: Pick a folder
folder.body: First choose (or drag in) the project folder the agent should work in. Nothing runs until you pick one. This highlighted button opens the folder picker.

controls.title: Your controls
controls.body: This row sets HOW the agent works: Mode (Plan = describe a plan first, Build = do it now), Agent (which coding agent), and Provider — where the models come from (Free, OpenGateway, Bankr, Surplus, or Venice).

compose.title: Type and send
compose.body: Write what you want in the box at the bottom and press the send button (or Enter). The agent will show its steps, file edits, and any preview as it works.

done.title: That is it
done.body: Pick a folder, choose Plan or Build, type your task, send. You can stop any time. Open this walkthrough again from the "How to" button up top.

appMode.title: TACHIAPP
appMode.heroTitle: Ask about the app — or tell it what to change.
appMode.heroBody: This chat is pinned to Tachi Studio's own source code. It reads the app, answers questions about it, and edits its own files. No folder to pick — just a provider and a model.
appMode.composerPlaceholder: Ask about the app, or describe the change… (Shift+Enter for newline)

locate.title: LOCATE APP SOURCE
locate.body: Tachi Studio could not find its own source folder. Point it at your checkout once — the one with AGENTS.md and apps/desktop inside — and it will never ask again.

surfaceBusy.title: ANOTHER RUN IS IN PROGRESS
surfaceBusy.bodyCode: A CODE run is still working. This chat opens as soon as it finishes — that transcript parks onto the CODE tab's history rail and opens there automatically.
surfaceBusy.bodyApp: A TACHIAPP run is still working. This tab is free as soon as it finishes — that transcript parks onto the TACHIAPP chat's history rail and opens there automatically.
